body:
Dose:20mg Oral
T+40: 30mg Oral
T+50 : 30mg Oral
T+55; 20mg Oral
100mg Total
Venue:School
1010:
Taken 2 Clobazam 10mg pills.
Small,White,Branded 'Frissum' [sic]
1015:
No effects, not that they were expected yet.
1020:
Warmth in legs first noticed
Increased appreciation of music/singing.
1030:
Warmth started in legs now permeates body, slight loss of coordination and mild euphoria.
Spelling an effort, similar to alcohol intoxication.
1035:
Inexplicable sweating noticed, thalmic disregulation?
1040:
Split second decision to ingest additional 30mg.
Impaired decision making seems evident at this point.
1055:
Time appears to be accelerating, felt like a minute or two since last report.
Intensive heaviness in limbs, difficulty walking straight (Classmates not noticed)
1100:
Extreme drooling noticed.
1100:
Additional 20mg ingested.
Extremes loss of reasoning
1115:
Entire blister empty totalling 100mg, this was not a smart move.
Standing straight Is near impossible.
Biology is all going over my head right now I can't even remember what chloramphenicol is and I work with it every day.
1130:
Everything seems hilarious, debating is fun as hell despite it being a dull topic.
1220:
Slept through biology, that's bad I didn't even notice I just collapsed and teacher commented as though I shouldn't be in school (Passed off as food poisoning, there was an incident of this recently)
It seems as though it's been only minutes since last report yet it's been almost an hour.
Most effects gone except extreme tiredness.
1230:
Memory both long and short term impacted, unable to recall basic facts.
Heaviness of limbs still present.
Euphoria not present and hasn't been for some time.
1240:
Sense of time almost gone, can't determine time passing... a minute feels like an hour till I look at a clock then it's been about 5, suddenly jumps to 5 or 10 minutes.
1255:
Seems like 3 minutes since last the time acceleration effects are incredible, warrant further investigation if I can acquire more of this substance. (Only had one blister)
1305:
About to queue for the lunch queue and it looks huge, be interesting to see how long it feels.
1315:
Felt like 2 minutes and now I'm eating, food tastes nicer than normal.
1325:/Conclusion
Effects are subsiding at last, this drug seems to have an incredible active half-life and I don't expect I'll be back to normal till tonight (20-70h) half life and since I ingested 100mg in total I don't expect to be ok for a day or two.
Effects mimic combined alcohol and benzodiazepam intoxication at such high doses...previous reports say 30mg had them incoherent and unable to perform basic function so I can assume a tolerance for this. An interesting if not fun drug to pass the time, time dilation effects seem to be very pronounced so good for a boring day... not so much for lessons.
Now dosing with 120mg pseudoephredine to counteract this tiredness but I think I'll stick to my tramadol/codeine/promtherazine combo in future.
1530:
Effects wearing off fully now after that huge dose.
Won't be trying that again, I've left things all over the place and have no memory of where.
Perhaps I'll stick to traditional benzos in future.
